booking.instructions: Call (941) 841-3499 to schedule an appointment, or leave your details here and we'll follow up by email.

demo_chips: What does the membership plan include?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Lefton Family Dentistry at (941) 841-3499 or leftondental@tdn.care, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.a: Our in-house membership is $395 and covers your exams and cleanings - a simple way to keep up with preventive care if you don't have dental insurance. Ask the team and they'll walk you through how it works.
faqs.q: What does the $395 in-house membership include?

faqs.a: Yes - insurance is welcome here, and we also offer flexible financing with quick pre-qualification that won't affect your credit. Call (941) 841-3499 and the team can check your coverage.
Yes - emergency dentistry is right in our name (Lefton Family & Emergency Dentistry). If you're in pain or a tooth breaks, call (941) 841-3499 and the team will help you as quickly as they can.

You're not alone - and this team is known for gentle, patient-focused care. We take time to explain everything, and options like laughing gas can help you relax through treatment. Many of our patients arrived feeling anxious and now actually look forward to visits.
faqs.q: I'm nervous about the dentist - can you help?

faqs.a: We're in Sarasota, Florida, at 1515 N Lockwood Ridge Rd - serving families across the Sarasota community.
Dr. Marc D. Lefton founded the practice in 1997, so we've served Sarasota for over 25 years. Dr. Lefton and Dr. Jensen Bouton lead the team, holding everyone to the highest standards of care.
faqs.q: How long have you been in practice?

pricing.summary: Treatment fees depend on the care you need, and there's no published fee list - the team walks you through your options and costs before anything is done. One number we do publish: our in-house membership is $395 and covers exams and cleanings. Insurance is welcome, and flexible financing is available with quick pre-qualification that won't affect your credit.
